ideas.title: The Great Wave, but with a cat
ideas.text: Hokusai's wave with a giant tabby surfing the crest. Keep the woodblock look.

ideas.title: Grande Jatte today
ideas.text: Seurat's Sunday afternoon, present day: phones, scooters, a food truck. Still all dots.

ideas.title: Cypresses as a tapestry?
ideas.text: Van Gogh's wheat field woven as a wool tapestry, visible threads.

ideas.title: National park posters for other planets
ideas.text: Ranger Naturalist Service posters for Olympus Mons, the rings of Saturn, Europa's ice.

ideas.title: Moonwalk postcard
ideas.text: Apollo 11 as a cheerful 1960s travel postcard: "Greetings from the Sea of Tranquility".

ideas.title: Harbour by lantern light
ideas.text: This photochrom of Mosman Bay at night: lantern-lit ferries, fireworks over the water.

ideas.title: Mika the courier
ideas.text: Original character. Cheerful bicycle courier, short teal hair, yellow raincoat, a small red fox rides in her front basket. Rainy harbour town.

ideas.title: Lighthouse keeper robot
ideas.text: A small rusty robot who keeps a lighthouse, polishing the lens at dawn. Storybook watercolour.

ideas.title: Neon sign of every museum painting
